text: Successfully **defended my PhD** (viva-voce) at IIT Kharagpur, supervised by Prof. Chirodeep Bakli.
Submitted my **PhD thesis**, *Transport control under confinement*, supervised by Prof. Chirodeep Bakli.
Physics-informed machine learning for graphene desalination membranes published in *Desalination*.
Two papers on **hydrogel passive cooling**, in *Solar RRL* and *Advanced Sustainable Systems*, both featured on the **journal covers**.
Presented my PhD **synopsis seminar** at IIT Kharagpur.
Our graphene-based oil–water separation work, led by Prof. Chirodeep Bakli, made the **front page of The Times of India** (Kolkata).
Our oil–water separation work made the **cover of *Nanoscale*** (vol. 16, issue 29).
